ui.intro: Guide to GitHub profile badges wey dey public, old, experimental or for staff.
ui.limits: Na badges wey public evidence dey we list; nobody fit confirm all secret staff experiments.
ui.incident: GitHub report delay for awarding and showing badges on 2026-09-23; missing badge no mean say dem stop am.
ui.active_note: Na community observation show these limits. Private contribution fit count if you switch the setting on.
ui.retired_note: These events don finish. Old awards fit remain; new contribution no go unlock dem.
ui.experimental_note: GitHub confirm say the March 2026 return na mistake; dem never announce public release date.
ui.internal_note: Na Proxima staff milestones; no public way to get am or confirmed date wey dem stop awarding am.
ui.tiers_note: Base → bronze → silver → gold. x2/x3/x4 na level labels. From 2026-09-11 profile dey show highest level.
ui.experimental_tiers: Experimental pictures dey; limits below na temporary community reports, no be confirmed rules.
ui.variants_note: Skin colour for Starstruck and Quickdraw dey change only how dem look.
ui.highlights_note: Highlights na separate program or account marks; availability depend on the program.
ui.history_note: First designs dey from 2021-04-19 to 2022-06-09; old names no be extra achievements.
ui.proxima_note: Screenshots match the cards: Pioneer — M0 prototype; Staffshipper — M8 instance; Staffuser — team joining.
ui.inaccessible_note: “inaccessible” mean say you no get access to the event. Staffshipper: screenshot show 2024-08-22, UTC show 2024-08-21.
ui.sources_note: Official announcements confirm status, profile cards confirm events; community limits still be observations.

descriptions.starstruck: Create repository wey reach **16 stars**; higher levels follow that repository star count.
descriptions.pull-shark: Write **2 pull requests wey dem merge**.
descriptions.pair-extraordinaire: Coauthor commits inside **1 merged PR**, with correct `Co-authored-by`.
descriptions.galaxy-brain: Get **2 accepted answers** for Discussions. Dem turn awards off for `github.com/orgs/community` from 2024-02-06.
descriptions.quickdraw: Close issue or PR **within 5 minutes** after you open am.
descriptions.yolo: Merge your own PR **without code review**; full official rules never come out.
descriptions.public-sponsor: Sponsor developer or organization publicly through **GitHub Sponsors**.
descriptions.arctic-code-vault-contributor: Contribute to eligible repository for **Arctic Code Vault snapshot of 2020-02-02**. The event don close.
descriptions.mars-2020-contributor: Write commit for the exact project version wey **NASA/JPL Ingenuity** use. The event don finish.
descriptions.heart-on-your-sleeve: Experiment with ❤️ reactions; dem reverse the mistaken March 2026 rollout. No confirmed way to get am now.
descriptions.open-sourcerer: Experiment with merged PRs across public repositories; exact rules never come out.
descriptions.proxima-pioneer: **M0 Participant** — contribute to **Proxima proof of concept (POC)**; we see am for @JakubOleksy.
descriptions.proxima-staffshipper: **M8 Participant** — launch **Proxima Staffship instance**; we see am for @JakubOleksy.
descriptions.proxima-staffuser: **Team join Proxima**; we see am for @timrogers. Na the third known Proxima award.

highlights.developer-program: Join Developer Program and build app with GitHub API.
highlights.bug-bounty: Report eligible GitHub security problem through Bug Bounty.
highlights.campus-expert: Join GitHub Campus Experts; check current application rules.
highlights.security-advisory: Get contribution credit for accepted security advisory in GitHub Advisory Database.
highlights.github-star: Make dem select you for GitHub Stars; repository stars alone no enough.
highlights.discussion-answered: Old mark for accepted answers; community report say Galaxy Brain replace am in 2022.
